decision: Headless-shell residency reduces complete-run time by about 7.0% off/on and about 3.5% against Playwright using median paired ratios. Delayed assertion ratios are 2.413 and 2.435. Neither comparison meets the declared 10% complete-flow target. Noop/navigation/failure median regressions and interaction observed-maximum regression remain in the matched Playwright profile. Keep residency opt-in pending remaining S12 resource/correctness gates.
interpretation: Both engines use the identical pinned headless-shell executable and flags within each comparison. Separate historical full-Chrome runs are not an alternating cross-distribution experiment and do not establish a causal browser-distribution speedup.
remaining: Resolve navigation/runtime-installation and small-call/failure regressions using the retained headless-shell attribution. Renderer initialization still dominates fresh-page setup; serial host command gaps are a smaller component.
Complete remaining resident-condition fairness/CPU and adversarial CSS-animation/font/suspended-frame checks before default enablement.
Continue M2 APIs, runner/artifacts and consumer installation; neither browser distribution completes a milestone or release gate.
